import pathlib
import tempfile
import unittest
import report

class ReportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_row(self):
        self.assertEqual(report.row_csv(['a,b', 'c']), '"a,b",c\n')
    def test_export(self):
        self.assertEqual(report.export_csv([['a,b', 'c']]), 'name,value\n"a,b",c\n')
        self.assertEqual(report.export_csv([]), 'name,value\n')
    def test_write(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = pathlib.Path(tmp) / 'report.csv'
            report.write_csv([['a', 'b']], path)
            self.assertEqual(path.read_text(), 'name,value\na,b\n')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
